name: Approve Invoices vs Process Payments
riskDescription: User can approve supplier invoices and release payment batches without independent verification.
howDetected: User holds privileges to both approve supplier invoices and process payment runs.
action: Revoke payment run execution privilege/role or reassign payment duty to a dedicated disbursement officer.

name: Enter Supplier Invoices vs Approve Supplier Invoices
riskDescription: User can create supplier invoices and approve them for payment, bypassing supervisory review.
howDetected: User possesses both invoice entry specialist privileges and invoice approval authority.
action: Enforce strict separation between Payables Data Entry and Payables Supervisory Approval.

name: Enter Supplier Invoices vs Process Payment Runs
riskDescription: User can enter fictitious invoices and subsequently select them into automated payment runs.
howDetected: User has end-to-end access across both invoice generation and payment disbursement privileges.
action: Revoke payment run execution permissions from payables entry clerks.

name: Create Journals vs Approve Journals
riskDescription: User can create manual general ledger journals and self-approve them without independent audit.
howDetected: General Ledger journal creation privilege combined with accounting manager journal approval permissions.
action: Enforce GL Journal workflow separation so preparers cannot approve their own journal entries.

name: Hire Workers vs Calculate Payroll
riskDescription: Risk of creating ghost employees and subsequently processing payroll disbursement to fraudulent accounts.
howDetected: User holds Core HR personnel onboarding rights combined with Payroll execution privileges.
action: Segregate Personnel Records administration from Payroll Calculation and Execution.

name: Hire Workers vs Maintain Salaries
riskDescription: User can onboard new workers and independently assign unapproved salary and compensation packages.
howDetected: Core HR specialist hiring privileges paired with Compensation salary administration permissions.
action: Restrict salary determination exclusively to the Compensation Department.

name: Maintain Salaries vs Approve Salary Changes
riskDescription: User can alter worker salary grades and approve the compensation change without higher authorization.
howDetected: User holds both Compensation Data Entry privileges and Compensation Management approval authority.
action: Remove Compensation Manager approval role from compensation administrative clerks.

name: Enter Time Cards vs Approve Time Cards
riskDescription: User can submit overtime or standard hours and approve their own timecard submissions.
howDetected: Timecard entry privilege combined with Manager Timecard approval workflow authorization.
action: Enable Oracle Time & Labor 'Prohibit User Self-Approval' policy in BPM Console.

name: Calculate Payroll vs Verify / Approve Payroll Results
riskDescription: User can run the payroll calculation process and sign off on gross-to-net results without secondary sign-off.
howDetected: Payroll administrator calculation execution privileges combined with managerial payroll sign-off authority.
action: Enforce strict separation between payroll calculation operators and payroll approval supervisors.

name: Create Purchase Orders vs Approve Purchase Orders
riskDescription: Buyer can raise purchasing contracts and self-approve orders beyond approval thresholds.
howDetected: Purchase order creation privileges combined with purchase order approval signing authority.
action: Ensure approval limits route orders above threshold to an independent departmental approver.

name: Create Purchase Orders vs Receive Goods & Services
riskDescription: User can order goods and confirm warehouse receipts, facilitating fictitious deliveries.
howDetected: Purchase order drafting privilege combined with Warehouse Goods Receipt entry privileges.
action: Separate purchasing functions from warehouse inventory receiving operations.

name: Security Administration vs Financial Transactions
riskDescription: IT Security Administrator holds business transactional capabilities, enabling them to alter security audit trails.
howDetected: User account grants both user security administration privileges and transactional disbursement authority.
action: Revoke all transactional and operational roles from IT Security administrator accounts.
